source: Decades in this liminal prison, this existence in the thin sliver, the border between life and death, between physical reality and bottomless dream, and my concern about the gem pendant necklace has not lifted. What more can I do than follow its path and observe the world around it? I am less than mist.. Less than light. I cannot influence. So I watch. I watched the gem necklace exchange hands. From Elijah Quail, drunken soldier turned turkey farmer and bar bouncer, to cabaret owner Madame Vivienne, to a person I never thought I’d see: the great Queen Sadie of Quent, but as a precocious child. I watched her chase a white raccoon and fall through the portal towards greatness, or perhaps for her, great sadness. The necklace was flung from her outstretched hands, into the dirt, covered then by windswept pine needles and leaves. Right below the area of the dimensional right, Sadie’s distraught father installed a symbolic grave for his daughter – the only place in the woods where bloodhounds caught a lingering scent. On occasion, across the years, he would show up stumbling, whiskey bottle sloshing in hand, and bemoan her loss and curse his God. Beyond him, no one visited. The pendant necklace remains beneath rotting needles and leaves, buried in nature’s detritus. Some nights, I wonder if I should ascend and disappear into the stars. Get the big view, the grand perspective, see the world from the moon, from our galaxy, from our universe… but I never leave. Tethered by “what if” to this plot of land. What if, while I’m gone, someone shows up? What if an animal takes the gem? What if the sluice from a sudden downpour washes the gem away? What if, what if, what if… So I watch. Ah there’s my friend – Clarak the centipede. Oh little Clarak, how I’ve watched you grow from your miniscule egg on the damp muck covering the gem. You little squirm you. Eating, growing and molting. I see you’ve captured another worm with your paralyzing venom. Savor it now, Clarak, slowly, with those claw-like mandibles tearing bits and pieces of flesh. Soon it will be time to molt again, and grow a new pair of legs…
target: 在这座交界牢笼里过了几十年，存在于薄薄的一线之中，位于生与死、物质现实与无底梦境的边界，我对那条宝石坠炼的牵挂始终未曾消散。 除了跟着它的轨迹，观察它周遭的世界，我还能做什么？我比雾还淡……比光还轻。我无法影响任何事。所以，我看着。 我看着宝石项链易手。从以利亚・奎尔——那个嗜酒的士兵，后来成了火鸡农夫和酒吧保镳——到了歌舞表演酒馆的老板薇薇安夫人手中。接着，它到了我从未想过会见到的人手上：昆特伟大的莎蒂女王，只不过，那时的她是个早慧的孩子。我看着她追逐一只白浣熊，跌进传送门，走向伟大；又或许对她而言，是巨大的悲伤。项链从她伸出的手里甩出去，落入泥土，又被风吹来的松针与落叶掩盖。 就在维度裂缝的下方，莎蒂悲痛欲绝的父亲为女儿立了一座象征性的坟墓——那是寻血猎犬在树林里唯一嗅到残留气味的地方。岁月流逝，偶尔，她父亲会踉跄着出现，手中威士忌酒瓶晃荡，哀悼失去的女儿，咒骂他的上帝。除了他，再没有人来访。坠炼仍躺在腐烂的松针与落叶底下，埋在自然的残屑之中。 有些夜晚，我想，也许该往上升，消失在星辰里。看看更大的景象，换个宏观的视角，从月球、从银河、从宇宙看世界……但我始终没离开。那些「万一」，把我拴在这块土地。万一我离开时，有人出现怎么办？万一动物叼走宝石怎么办？万一突如其来的暴雨，让水流把宝石冲走怎么办？万一，万一，万一…… 所以，我看着。 啊，我的朋友来了——蜈蚣克拉克。噢，小克拉克，我看着你从覆在宝石上的湿泥里，那颗微小的卵，一路长大。你这小扭扭虫。吃东西、长大、蜕皮。我看见你又用麻痹毒液捉到一条虫。慢慢享用吧，克拉克，用你那爪子般的大腭，一小块、一小块撕下牠的肉。很快，你又该蜕皮，再长出一对脚了……

source: This build includes numerous fixes recommended by our beta test community. Thanks beta testers, we appreciate your efforts to improve the game. We tried to list members of our community for the issues they uncovered, but apologies in advance if we missed you! Changes - Timeline header information organized and updated with critical world building details. - Help manual content updated. - Game now starts in a "Maximized Window" state, this should limit instances of the missing "OKAY" button on the present era intro banner. Workaround for this issue added to the FAQ. @IceandJunk, @Everlosst, @Elivercury, @shortphotoguy - Add buttons to tabs that appear along bottom of screen. These can be clicked to instantly navigate (horizontally and vertically) to era-specific content. This should greatly improve QoL in the domain of navigation. In addition, these buttons can be accessed with individual hotkeys and the left \ right arrow keys. @motas, @many - Several story-specific UI problems resolved. @Soleful Phoenix, @ShadowKnightEx, @Smoncko - Death notifications no longer get stuck in the on state. @Soleful Phoenix, @Arcanestomper, @ShadowKnightEx, @Furak, @Yettum - Current action in character selection menus no longer blocks other characters. @Ritsu Voices, @Yettum - Added a popup encouraging the use of 1x mode. - Some quest grid character icons corrected. @Ritsu Voices, @QuackenAsh, @IceandJunk - Certain artifacts have more accurate lists of examiners now. @Soleful Phoenix, @Furak - Production flow explanation popups are now accurately displayed. @realms256, @Arcanestomper - When characters finish their final event, they no longer have small amount of exp missing (like 999/1000). @Ritsu Voices, @HibouProfene - Community FAQ created (and included in the in-game help manual). @Kurut08 - Many typos resolved. @Kurut08, @Soleful Phoenix, @Emilorzz, @Yettum, @Pellia, @Galya, @Motas, @Arcanestomper, @HibouProfene, @Emilorzz, @Sir James, friend of The Colonel - UI scale renamed to UI Zoom (to avoid confusion). @j.k. r evo
target: 这个版本包含许多依 Beta 测试社群建议进行的修正。感谢各位测试玩家为改善游戏付出的努力。我们尽量在各项问题旁列出发现问题的社群成员，若有遗漏，先向各位致歉！ 变更 - 整理并更新时间轴标头资讯，补上重要的世界观细节。 - 更新说明手册内容。 - 游戏现在以「最大化视窗」启动，应可减少现代时代介绍横幅的「确定」按钮消失的情况。常见问题也加入了暂时解决方法。@IceandJunk, @Everlosst, @Elivercury, @shortphotoguy - 在画面底部的分页加入按钮，点选即可水平与垂直移动至指定时代的内容，大幅改善导览便利性。这些按钮也能透过个别快捷键及左／右方向键操作。@motas, @many - 修正数个特定故事的介面问题。@Soleful Phoenix, @ShadowKnightEx, @Smoncko - 死亡通知不再卡住而持续显示。@Soleful Phoenix, @Arcanestomper, @ShadowKnightEx, @Furak, @Yettum - 角色选单中的目前行动不再遮住其他角色。@Ritsu Voices, @Yettum - 加入鼓励使用 1 倍速模式的提示视窗。 - 修正部分任务网格的角色图示。@Ritsu Voices, @QuackenAsh, @IceandJunk - 部分文物的检视者清单现在更准确。@Soleful Phoenix, @Furak - 生产流动说明视窗现在可正确显示。@realms256, @Arcanestomper - 角色完成最后一个事件后，不再缺少少量经验值，例如 999/1000。@Ritsu Voices, @HibouProfene - 建立社群常见问题，并纳入游戏内说明手册。@Kurut08 - 修正许多错字。@Kurut08, @Soleful Phoenix, @Emilorzz, @Yettum, @Pellia, @Galya, @Motas, @Arcanestomper, @HibouProfene, @Emilorzz, @Sir James, friend of The Colonel - 将 UI Scale 改名为 UI Zoom，以避免混淆。@j.k. r evo

source: This patch addresses a wide range of issues raised by the community. This may be the final QoL patch for a while, as our efforts will now focus on some larger, but also exciting, additions to story and mechanics. Changes - High-tech journals \ Quent stories are now easier to read. @dunvi - The "+1" icons for nature locations now appear below the mouseover text layer. @Landvogt90 - The "DM a developer" end-game text has been changed to a "post in the discord" text. - The game will now compare and apply the largest cost reduction bonus for work location building input resources (applies when Elder Council and Technocratic Monarchy are both active). - Perks and Main Quest no longer count towards the total for game completion (as these accomplishments are redundant copies of other accomplishments). - EXP tooltip now works for all unknown story notes. - EXP tooltip now displays correct values. @Shogun - In settings UI Scaling / Resolution settings have been cleaned up and are more understandable. - Widescreens will no longer default to a very large UI scale, requiring reduction via the settings. - Snails and EXP achievements are not rechecked at game launch (any single game with enough of the required resources will unlock the associated achievement). - Government, Science, and Religion victory page buttons now work. @Joshua - Can now close top layer popups when Story and Completion popups are simultaneously open. - UI tooltips are no longer too tall in early game (due to lack of explanatory / breakdown lines at that time).
target: 这次更新处理了社群提出的各种问题。这可能是近期最后一次便利性更新，因为我们接下来将专注于规模更大、也更令人期待的故事与机制新增内容。 变更 - 高科技日志与昆特故事现在更容易阅读。@dunvi - 自然地点的「+1」图示现在显示于滑鼠悬停文字图层下方。@Landvogt90 - 游戏结束时的「私讯开发者」文字，改为「在 Discord 发文」。 - 游戏现在会比较并套用最高的工作地点建造资源消耗减免加成；适用于长老议会与技术官僚君主制同时生效时。 - 加成与主线任务不再列入游戏总完成度，因为这些项目与其他完成项目重复。 - 经验值提示现在适用于所有未知故事笔记。 - 经验值提示现在会显示正确数值。@Shogun - 整理设定中的介面缩放与解析度选项，使其更容易理解。 - 宽萤幕不再预设使用过大的介面缩放，避免玩家必须到设定中调小。 - 启动游戏时不会重新检查蜗牛与经验值成就；任何单一存档只要拥有足够的指定资源，即可解锁相关成就。 - 完成度页面的政体、科学与宗教按钮现在可正常使用。@Joshua - 故事与完成提示视窗同时开启时，现在可以关闭最上层的视窗。 - 游戏初期的介面提示不再过高；先前是因为当时缺少说明与明细文字所致。

source: We’re continuing to address a wide range of issues raised by the community. In this update we focused on improving text readability for users. Font sizes may now be customized to the user's liking, and we have greatly improved the quality of our "Friendly Font Mode" (which now applies only to non-print stories). Because our stories are often highly graphical, we created two separate settings: one for controlling the font size of the UI fonts, and one for controlling the general scale of the story popup window. This allows stories to be enlarged w\o altering their original design. Additionally, when working in concert, these changes should greatly improve the quality of life for Steam Deck users. Much has changed in this update, so please bear with us, and please report any new strange behavior that you find! Changes - Added a setting to change UI font size. @Dictator Kitten, @Harmonica - Added a setting to change story UI size. - Friendly Font Mode now only applies to non-print stories. - Friendly Font Mode has been greatly improved. @damousey, @Smoncko, @Arcanestomper, @Emillie, @Zouls - Steam Deck Mode is no longer forced when screen resolution is 1280x800. @AlmondRoll - UI Scale, Font Size, and Story Size may now be adjusted on Steam Deck. - Fixed an issue where Era Banner graphics were failing to sliding away when "B" was pressed on Steam Deck. @BulletDetector42
target: 我们持续处理社群提出的各种问题。本次更新着重于改善文字阅读体验。玩家现在能依喜好调整字体大小，而「易读字型模式」的品质也大幅提升，目前仅套用于非印刷体故事。 由于故事经常结合大量图像，我们提供两项独立设定：一项控制介面字体大小，另一项控制故事视窗的整体缩放。如此便能放大故事，同时保留原本的设计。 此外，这些调整搭配使用，应可大幅改善 Steam Deck 玩家的体验。本次更新的变动很多，请多包涵；若发现新的异常情况，也请回报！ 变更 - 新增介面字体大小设定。@Dictator Kitten, @Harmonica - 新增故事介面大小设定。 - 易读字型模式现在仅套用于非印刷体故事。 - 大幅改善易读字型模式。@damousey, @Smoncko, @Arcanestomper, @Emillie, @Zouls - 萤幕解析度为 1280×800 时，不再强制启用 Steam Deck 模式。@AlmondRoll - 现在能在 Steam Deck 上调整介面缩放、字体大小与故事大小。 - 修正 Steam Deck 按下「B」后，时代横幅图像未滑出画面的问题。@BulletDetector42

source: This build contains the perks system, which is composed of the Religion, Government, and Science pages. In addition to these pages, obtaining perks led to the need for a number of UI tooltips and UI notes which gives transparency to the player regarding the effect perks have on other systems. Perks have been given initial values, but we expect to adjust these values as required. Changes - Perks Page created. - Religion Page & Religion perks created. - Government Page & Government perks created. - Science Page & Science perks created. - Final story adjustments applied to stories. - Help Manual completed. - Character selector menus split into columns for cases when there are many characters to select from. - Character Skills Popup updated to show unique abilities of characters. - Victory Page categories now match the left panel categories. - Notification animations adjusted to account for heavy notification flow in the late game. - Improved game performance by pooling notifications instead of instantiating them. - Fixed an issue that erroneous displayed character names in character selectors before they were revealed. - Improved game performance by eliminating unnecessary page update calls. - Added statistics to game saves for development analysis. - Nature cards now have inputs and outputs similar to other cards, for consistency.
target: 这个版本加入了由宗教、政体与科学页面组成的加成系统。除了这些页面，也新增多种介面提示与说明，让玩家清楚理解取得的加成如何影响其他系统。加成目前已设定初始数值，之后预计会视需要调整。 变更 - 建立加成页面。 - 建立宗教页面与宗教加成。 - 建立政体页面与政体加成。 - 建立科学页面与科学加成。 - 套用故事的最后调整。 - 完成说明手册。 - 可选角色很多时，角色选单会分成多栏。 - 更新角色技能视窗，显示角色的独特能力。 - 完成度页面的分类现在与左侧面板一致。 - 调整通知动画，以因应游戏后期的大量通知。 - 使用通知物件池取代每次建立新物件，以改善游戏效能。 - 修正尚未揭露的角色姓名错误显示在角色选单中的问题。 - 移除不必要的页面更新呼叫，以改善游戏效能。 - 在存档中加入统计资料，供开发分析使用。 - 自然卡片现在与其他卡片一样具有输入与输出栏位，以维持一致。

source: When the young warriors toil with making spirit shields, then it is certain: a great fear has invaded our people. First there was a sighting by the children. “U'tlun'ta'!” they cried, “It is Spearfinger!” They clung to my robe and flitted around me like startled chickadees. Who told them about this legend, this witch with a dress of stone and a sharp finger for cutting out livers to eat? I had thought it was our scamp kanohetlvsgi, our storyteller, giving the young ones a fright, telling them that the witch lurks in our woods. He denied this. But he denies much. Then Ostenaco, Big Head, the most serious young man, woke me suddenly in the afternoon six moons ago. He said Spearfinger approached him and his friends who were fishing in the red stream. They ran at the sight of a strange woman in a dress that shone like wet stone in sunlight, her left hand bearing a claw-like finger. That was the first time I heard his voice shake. And two mornings ago Immokalee, Tumbling Water, aged but thirteen harvests, was found dead by the red stream. Little neck snapped. Pouch of mulberries spilled. Tracks leading away from her body. A great fear has taken us. I know what I must do. It will take all my strength.
target: 当年轻战士忙着制作灵盾，便能确定：巨大的恐惧已侵入族人。 最先看见的是孩子。 「U'tlun'ta'！」他们哭喊，「是矛指！」抓着我的袍子，像受惊山雀般绕着我。谁告诉他们这传说？那个穿石衣、以尖指挖肝来吃的女巫？ 我以为是我们顽皮的 kanohetlvsgi，说书人，说女巫藏在树林，吓唬孩子。他否认，可他什么都否认。 接着，六个月前的午后，最严肃的年轻人 Ostenaco，大头，突然叫醒我。他说，他和朋友在红溪钓鱼，矛指走近。他们看见一个奇怪女人，衣服如阳光下的湿石般发亮，左手有爪般的长指，立刻逃跑。那是我第一次听见他声音颤抖。 两个早晨前，才经历十三次收获的 Immokalee，翻腾之水，被发现死在红溪旁。小小脖子折断，袋里桑葚散落。脚印从尸体旁离去。 巨大的恐惧攫住我们。我知道必须做什么。 这将耗尽我的力量。

source: Testing a variety of economic balance adjustments. Also includes the following bug fixes & quality of life updates. Changes - Quest tree now correctly instantiated. - Delete Game Button invokes a confirmation popup now. - Games are backed up to the Autosaves folder every time a new character is unlocked. - When deleting games, deleted games are backed up to the Autosaves folder. - When Science, Government, and Religion are completed, character selectors are hidden by a "Completed" banner. - Gap removed from top of Nature Page. - Speed mode toggle now works. - In character selection menus (e.g. on the Scavenging Page), character state tooltip will include information about the blocked status of characters, thereby making it easier to select workers. Thank you to @TheSecondSpoon and @Linguini for independently reporting this issue! - Characters that finish their lives will move to Idle now, instead of "Blocked". - Resource dropdown no longer blocked by left panel on character pages. - Steam Friend Status now populated by current page & current overall percent. These features can be disabled if desired in the settings pages. Thank you to our community for helping to define this feature! - Research timers now display time remaining.
target: 测试各种经济平衡调整，也包含以下错误修正与便利性更新。 变更 - 任务树现在会正确建立。 - 删除游戏按钮现在会显示确认视窗。 - 每次解锁新角色，都会将游戏备份至 Autosaves 资料夹。 - 删除游戏时，会将被删除的游戏备份至 Autosaves 资料夹。 - 科学、政体与宗教完成后，角色选单会被「已完成」横幅覆盖。 - 移除自然页面顶端的空隙。 - 速度模式切换现在可正常使用。 - 角色选单，例如拾荒页面的选单，其角色状态提示会包含角色受阻的资讯，让挑选工人更方便。感谢 @TheSecondSpoon 与 @Linguini 分别回报这个问题！ - 角色的人生结束后，现在会转为闲置，而非「受阻」。 - 角色页面的资源下拉选单不再被左侧面板遮住。 - Steam 好友状态现在会显示目前页面与整体完成百分比。若有需要，可在设定页面停用这些功能。感谢社群协助规划这项功能！ - 研究计时器现在会显示剩余时间。

source:
Vessel of enlightened consciousness, Isaiah Kosztka, hereby joyously vows to serve as Pathfinder to the Lost. 

Pathfinder is Highest Enlightened, Master of the Grand Plan for Universal Enlightenment, and Great Protector of the Commune for the Lost. Pathfinder is the guide who opens the third eye for each soul to see their golden path. The golden path is borne of psychedelic ritual and founded on love and empathy. Pathfinder holds the sacred duty to grow and defend the Commune. 

Vessel of enlightened consciousness, Romina Zappa, hereby joyously vows to serve as Gatekeeper to the Commune for the Lost. 

Gatekeeper is the Seeker of Lost Souls. Gatekeeper finds the downtrodden, the rejected, the yearning, and the hopeful, and brings them to join the Commune. Gatekeeper assists with the opening of the third eye and assures the one-eyed angel welcomes lost souls as they pass through to the enlightened plane. This is the golden path of the Gatekeeper. Gatekeeper holds the sacred duty to expand the membership of the Commune. 

I, Pathfinder, With My Own Lifeblood Vow to Uphold My Radical Purpose

Isaiash Kosztka
